title: Best cheap grocery stores in Austin, TX
content: H-E-B on Burnet Road in Austin remains the go-to for budget shoppers. A gallon of milk runs $3.49 and a dozen eggs is $2.98. Trader Joe's on Lamar Blvd sells a loaf of sandwich bread for $2.99.

title: Aldi Austin locations and prices
content: ALDI Austin, TX carries a dozen large eggs for $2.45 and a gallon of whole milk for $2.89.

title: Grocery price comparison, Texas
content: Walmart Supercenter in Round Rock sells bananas at $0.54 per pound.
